title: Identification of pre-stellar cores in high-mass star forming clumps via H<SUB>2</SUB>D<SUP>+</SUP> observations with ALMA
question: Identify the prestellar core population in two infrared-dark massive clumps via ortho-H2D+ with ALMA and measure their physical and chemical properties (linewidths, column densities, masses, virial state)

data.sensitivity: continuum 0.8 mJy/beam (both sources); line median rms 300 mK per 0.22 km/s (primary-beam corrected)

recipe.goal: calibrate and combine ACA and 12m visibilities
recipe.method: Standard ALMA pipeline in CASA 5.4, then ACA weights modified and ACA plus 12m data concatenated
key_parameters: ACA visibility weight factor 2.4

recipe.method: tclean interactively with natural weighting and multiscale deconvolver; continuum from dedicated SPW plus line-free channels; 100-channel line cube; regrid to 3 pixels per beam; convert to brightness temperature
key_parameters: Continuum total bandwidth about 4.2 GHz
Cube spectral resolution 0.22 km/s
3 pixels per beam minor axis
Jy/beam to brightness temperature gain G = 11 mK/(mJy/beam) at beam 1x0.8 arcsec

recipe.method: SCIMES (dendrogram leaves) on the o-H2D+ cubes before primary-beam correction; leaves treated as prestellar cores; 7 cores in AG351 and 9 in AG354
key_parameters: S/N_peak = 2; S/N_lim = 1.5 (AG351), 1.3 (AG354); min_val = 0
Delta_min = 2.0 x rms with rms = 150 mK (before primary-beam correction)
Minimum channels per leaf = 2; leaves smaller than twice the beam area excluded

recipe.goal: fit o-H2D+ spectra pixel by pixel
recipe.method: MCWEEDS: LTE synthetic spectra (WEEDS/GILDAS) with Bayesian MCMC (PyMC); free N_col, V_lsr, FWHM; T_ex fixed at 10 K; results masked where FWHM exceeds a per-core threshold
key_parameters: 100000 iterations per spectrum, first 1000 steps burn-in
Noise rms 180 mK (AG351), 170 mK (AG354)
Fits with FWHM above a per-core threshold of 1-1.2 km/s discarded (<=3% of pixels)
assumptions: T_ex = 10 K (single transition cannot constrain N_col and T_ex independently); LTE

recipe.method: Optical depth computed from fitted N_col maps with the LTE formula using CDMS spectroscopic parameters

recipe.goal: average spectra per core and decompose linewidth
recipe.method: Spectra in each core aligned to the mean centroid velocity, averaged, refitted with MCWEEDS (T_ex = 10 K); non-thermal and thermal dispersion separated in quadrature to give 1D turbulent Mach number
key_parameters: Mach number computed at T_gas = 10 K (sigma_th = 0.14 km/s); c_s = 0.19 km/s with mu = 2.33
assumptions: Thermal and non-thermal components independent and sum in quadrature

recipe.goal: derive gas temperature upper limit from linewidth
recipe.method: Set observed sigma_V equal to the thermal dispersion of H2D+ to get T_H2D+ per pixel; bounded to 5-20 K
key_parameters: Lower limit 5 K, upper limit 20 K (H2D+ abundance expected to drop above 20 K)
assumptions: All observed linewidth is thermal (so T is an upper limit)

recipe.method: M_vir = 5 R sigma_dyn^2 / G with R_core = R_eff and sigma_dyn from the fitted sigma_V; done at constant 10 K and at T_min of each core; distributions propagated to median and 95% HPD
key_parameters: Constant gas temperature 10 K, and T_min from step 7
assumptions: Spherical uniform-density core; non-thermal component equal for all gas components

recipe.goal: dust column density, core masses and densities from continuum
recipe.method: Pixel-by-pixel N(H2) and total core mass from 0.8 mm dust emission, computed at T_dust = 10 K and at T_min; M_core only for cores with peak flux above 5 sigma; volume density from M_core and R_eff for a uniform sphere
key_parameters: Dust opacity kappa = 1.71 cm2/g at the observed frequency (kappa_0 = 10 cm2/g at 250 um, beta = 1.5)
Gas-to-dust ratio 100; mu_H2 = 2.8
Mass uncertainty set to 33% (30% kappa variation gives 33% in mass)
assumptions: T_dust = T_gas = 10 K (dust-gas coupling at high density); also re-done with T_H2D+ maps and T_min

recipe.goal: virial parameter, Jeans mass and required magnetic field
recipe.method: alpha_vir = M_vir / M_core at 10 K and T_min; Jeans masses for n = 1e6-1e7 cm-3 and 5-10 K; magnetic field estimated from U + 2T + Omega_B = 0
assumptions: Homogeneous spherical core with uniform magnetic field for Omega_B

recipe.method: astrodendro dendrogram on the 0.8 mm continuum maps, masses at 5, 10 and 20 K; 15 cores found
key_parameters: min_val = 3 sigma, Delta_min = 1 sigma, min_area = 2 beams; 1 sigma = 0.5 mJy/beam (before primary-beam correction)

recipe.method: APEX spectra converted to flux and compared with ALMA integrated over the APEX beam and smoothed to 0.55 km/s; continuum compared with ATLASGAL 870 um over the ALMA field
key_parameters: APEX gain 40 Jy/K
